actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE complete NEW full-body FRONT VIEW of the adult woman Bunny, from a blank canvas, as the next cumulative footwear layer. Do not paste or locally repair either reference.
Reference 1 is the authoritative current character and previous clothing layer: identity, slim long-legged body, face/head size, shoulder/waist/hip proportions, torso length, chest/hip volume, relaxed standing stance, silver-white hair, tiny ears close to the head, blue eyes, white high-neck sleeveless cropped top with front oval cutout, red rolled-hem shorts and asymmetric socks. Preserve these and the clean hand-drawn cel style.
Reference 2 is the newly clarified footwear direction ONLY. Its seven panels depict the RIGHT BOOT, with outer and inner faces clearly different. Adopt this exact red/white/orange/black shoe design and create a correctly handed pair for reference 1. No board, labels or other drawing from reference 2 should appear in the final.

View and left/right: strict straight-on front, full hair to sole, hands relaxed to sides. Character RIGHT leg is on SCREEN LEFT and wears the WHITE calf sock. Character LEFT leg is on SCREEN RIGHT and wears the ORANGE thigh-high sock. Do not swap them or add further equipment.
For the WHITE-sock right boot, its outer edge is SCREEN LEFT: large black-and-orange outer-ankle disc and small orange forefoot/outsole ring must both be on the far LEFT edge. For the ORANGE-sock left boot, its outer edge is SCREEN RIGHT: both external circular details must be on the far RIGHT edge. The two inner sides between the feet have NO large ankle circles and NO little orange toe rings. In this frontal camera the lateral ankle discs are only narrow edge profiles; never turn them face-on. Differentiate each large ankle disc (near the ankle) from its smaller forefoot orange ring (near the sole).
Each shoe: red high-top upper, white toe insert and collar lining, orange tongue under white X laces through black eyelets; closed red upper tongue flap with one gray three-slot plaque and THREE small yellow-orange squares. White knot and short tails stored inside the top tongue pocket, nothing dangling. Black front toe bumper with FOUR small silver studs, a single continuous white midsole, segmented black lug outsole with red sidewall blocks and the outer heel badge. The same exact components must be on both boots in physically correct left/right positions. Front shoes stay near-front-view rather than one being an exaggerated side view.
Fit: ankle discs sit beside the ankle joints, not halfway up the shins. Boot collars sit just above the ankles, socks flow continuously inside them, and the boots contain the existing feet. Add sole thickness below the footbed. Preserve anatomical body ratios and knee-to-ankle length; do not compress lower legs to keep the old barefoot ground line. Uniform scale of the entire figure for canvas margins is allowed; independent shrinking or shortening of legs/body is not. Leave clear white margin below the new soles, with no cropped hair or feet.
Art: Japanese 2D hand-drawn model-sheet illustration; clean confident outlines with a little line-weight variation; continuous flat local colors; sparse clean hard-edged cel shadows only. Match reference 1's silver-white hair, pale cool hair shadows, warm skin, deep red shorts and orange sock. Smooth red fabric planes without pale/cloudy patches. Plain white background, one figure, no text.
No gloves, wrist devices, thigh straps/boxes, jacket, harness, headgear or weapons. No proportion redesign, fattening, short legs, long waist, flattened hips, enlarged detached ears, skin-colored hair tufts, photoreal or 3D rendering, soft airbrush shading, mosaics, flecks or mottled cloudy texture. Portrait native canvas; target 1024x1536 if available.

actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a complete NEW full-body RIGHT SIDE PROFILE of adult Bunny, facing SCREEN RIGHT, from a blank canvas. This is a complete character drawing, not a patch or pasted footwear.
Image 1 is the accepted current side body and cumulative clothing. Its anatomy, face, head/body ratio, chest projection, short natural waist, rounded buttocks, hanging hand, thigh/calf proportions and white sock are authoritative. Image 2 is ONLY the exact shoe construction/palette; panel 02 OUTER is the visible right boot. No frontal-character reference is supplied.
Add only this red-and-white boot to the visible white-sock right foot. Maintain the precisely overlapped profile pose: far orange-sock left leg and its boot are naturally hidden behind the near leg, not forced into view. Same white sleeveless high-neck crop top with barely visible front cutout, same red cuffed shorts with side/back pocket placement, same white calf sock.

Composition and anatomical fit are essential: retain the complete body in image 1 at ONE consistent slightly smaller scale, approximately 96% of the reference figure, to reserve about 50-60 pixels of extra space BELOW the reference bare/socked foot for the boot sole on a 1024x1536 portrait. This is a whole-character layout adjustment, not a shorter calf or smaller foot. Keep head-to-body, shoulder-to-hip, thigh-to-calf and knee-to-ankle ratios unchanged. The original socked heel/sole position, after this uniform whole-character scaling, is the shoe's INTERNAL footbed; the thick outsole must lie BELOW it. Do not place the new external sole on the old internal footbed and push the foot upward. Keep the toe room and heel-under-calf axis anatomically plausible. Full hair and soles with white margins.
